rows.text: Madam Scarred Eye, board member of the IPC, sits across from you. A long and narrow scar cuts through her left eye. You can sense her gaze on you, and you know she is not to be trifled with.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You are sitting here because of her overwhelming intimidation. A maid offers her a glass of champagne, and softly kisses the back of her hand.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "The planet Evelli is hit by a financial crisis," Madam Scarred Eye announces. "To help them tide over, our Business Consolidation Department has launched the Angel-type I.O.U. Dispenser. I'll make you an irresistible offer."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Buy the IPC's debt, wait for this catastrophe to be over, and the IPC will pay you an amount more than ten times your principal."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The servant next to Madam Scarred Eye pushes out a robot angel with wings. "This is the Angel-type I.O.U. Dispenser. You need to feed Gold Coins into it regularly, and it will keep a record of your investment. At the end of the investment term, it will pay you an amount more than ten times your principal."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The Interastral Peace Corporation is definitely not a charity!
"You have no idea what you have missed out on," Madam Scarred Eye remarks. "Every worker would be thrilled to be given such an opportunity. After all, this is an 'era of opportunism'."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "We can solve your deprivation by offering you a 'chance' to get what you want," Madam Scarred Eye adds.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Of course. Your return on investment will be above 1000%, as long as you are certain that your deprivation is in terms of 'materialism'. Qlipoth blesses us." Madam Scarred Eye states.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Of course. Love can be a universal currency, and it is something we mass-produce. The Interastral Peace Corporation endeavors to provide everyone with an endless supply of love. Qlipoth blesses us." Madam Scarred Eye states.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: I don't want anything. This is very nihilistic.
